title: Admin updates System Settings
description: Update Public Achievements from System Settings: Apply Set all to 3, change Biggest upset to 1, then Save — the values stay after save.

steps.title: System Settings
steps.body: Club Name and Timezone stay at the top. Expandable sections below include Tournament Rules and Public Achievements.

steps.title: Open Public Achievements
steps.body: Public Achievements controls how many results each board shows on the public achievements page (0 hides a board).

steps.title: Set all boards to 3
steps.body: Enter 3 in Set all to, then Apply to all so every achievement board uses the same list length.

steps.title: All boards at 3
steps.body: Every achievement board now shows 3. Next, override one board individually.
steps.resultNote: Apply to all filled each board with 3.

steps.title: Select Biggest upset
steps.body: Click the Biggest upset value to edit that board only. It still shows 3 from Apply to all.

steps.title: Biggest upset set to 1
steps.body: Change Biggest upset to 1. Other boards remain at 3.

steps.title: Save System Settings
steps.body: The floating bar shows Unsaved changes. Click Save to persist Biggest upset = 1 and the other boards at 3.

steps.title: Settings saved
steps.body: After Save, the values stay the same: Biggest upset is still 1 and the other boards are still 3. The bar shows All saved.
steps.resultNote: Saved values unchanged — Biggest upset 1, others 3.
